dataset_name: Samut Songkhram coastal erosion and mangrove satellite dataset
tide_policy: No tide level is inferred without a sourced station record. Missing tide information is tide_status=unverified.
shoreline_policy: Image-derived water-land boundaries are observations/proxies, not 'true shoreline', until tide effects and field/independent evidence are controlled.
git_lfs_status: tracking rules prepared; runtime git lfs env/quota not verifiable through GitHub API; no raster committed
notes: Scene catalogs are intentionally header-only until STAC acquisition is executed in a network-enabled runtime.
Large rasters must not be committed unless Git LFS availability and quota are verified first.
